mission: Add recent public research results (2026-04-18 to 2026-10-18) as frontier public-result nodes linked to the existing concepts they name
source_policy: Crossref REST work records (metadata CC0; abstracts used only where the record lists a CC BY 4.0 or CC0 licence); one retained capture per paper.
notes: Directly authored by deterministic code (frontier_author.py). One paper -> one frontier public-result node: frontier:true, status/era frontier, public_frontier public-result with disclosed_at = the date stated in the retained record. Quote = exact finding sentence of the abstract plus exact date and licence spans. Link = one related edge to an existing same-family concept named in the abstract (subject-category field + label match), or a narrower placement only where the abstract itself classifies the work as that concept; at most 25 new links per concept and parents below 100 children. Deduplicated against map ids, labels, aliases, source DOIs/arXiv ids, open PRs and other batches. REVIEW: code-only (code:nemesis-provenance/1) under owner waiver code-provenance-frontier-public-results (2026-10-18). No adversarial model review is claimed.
